bio.ko: 1871년 체르니고프현의 몰락한 귀족 집안에서 태어나 혁명 서클에 참여했다가 1889년 체포되어 「크레스티」 감옥 독방에서 1년을 보냈다. 1896년부터 젬스트보 통계 기관에서 일했고 1903년 러시아 사회민주노동당 볼셰비키 분파에 합류했다. 1917년 랴잔 노동자 대표 소비에트 간부회에 들어갔고 볼셰비키 명부로 제헌의회 의원에 선출되었다. 1918년 4월 러시아 공화국 농업인민위원이 되어 국영농장(소프호스)과 노동 코뮌 창설을 주도했다. 1920년 12월 건강을 이유로 사임을 청한 뒤 최고국민경제회의 간부회원, 1927~1930년 러시아 공화국 중앙통계국장, 1930~1933년 러시아 공화국 인민위원회의 부의장을 지냈다.
bio.en: Born in 1871 into an impoverished noble family in Chernigov Governorate, he joined a revolutionary circle, was arrested in 1889 and spent a year in solitary confinement in the Kresty prison. From 1896 he worked in zemstvo statistical offices, and in 1903 he joined the Bolshevik faction of the RSDLP. In 1917 he sat on the presidium of the Ryazan Soviet of Workers’ Deputies and was elected to the Constituent Assembly on the Bolshevik list. Appointed RSFSR People’s Commissar of Agriculture in April 1918, he was one of the main initiators of state farms and labour communes. After asking to be relieved for health reasons in December 1920 he sat on the presidium of the Supreme Council of the National Economy, headed the RSFSR Central Statistical Administration in 1927–1930 and was deputy chairman of the RSFSR Council of People’s Commissars in 1930–1933.

bio.ko: 1889년 예니세이현 타세예보 마을의 농민 집안에서 태어나 9살에 고아가 되어 머슴으로 일했고, 제1차 세계대전에 하사관으로 참전했다. 1917년 7월 러시아 사회민주노동당(볼셰비키)에 들어갔다. 1918년 12월 타세예보 봉기를 이끌어 콜차크군에 맞선 빨치산 투쟁을 조직했고, 타세예보 빨치산 공화국 군사혁명참모부 의장과 북칸스크 빨치산 전선 군 소비에트·참모부 의장을 지냈다. 1922년 1월 러시아 공화국 농업인민위원에 임명되어 신경제정책의 열렬한 지지자로 꼽혔고, 1923~1926년 사회보장인민위원을 지냈다. 1937년 2월 체포되어 7월 29일 소련 최고재판소 군사참의원의 사형 선고를 받고 같은 날 총살되었으며, 1956년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1889 into a peasant family in Taseyevo, Yeniseysk Governorate, he was orphaned at nine and worked as a farmhand, then fought in the First World War as a non-commissioned officer. He joined the RSDLP(b) in July 1917. In December 1918 he led the Taseyevo uprising and organised partisan warfare against Kolchak’s forces, chairing the military-revolutionary staff of the Taseyevo Partisan Republic and then the army council and staff of the North Kansk partisan front. Appointed RSFSR People’s Commissar of Agriculture in January 1922, he was known as an ardent supporter of the NEP, and in 1923–1926 he was People’s Commissar of Social Security. Arrested in February 1937, he was sentenced to death by the Military Collegium of the Supreme Court on 29 July and shot the same day; he was rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.en: Born in 1881 in Meshchovsk, Kaluga Governorate, he worked as a turner at the Bryansk locomotive works, joined the RSDLP in 1898 and spent 1907–1915 in prison and exile. After the October Revolution he chaired the Petrograd provincial party committee and was deputy chairman of the provincial executive committee as a follower of Zinoviev; in 1920 he briefly adhered to the Workers’ Opposition before leaving it. He led the party in the Far East in 1922–1927, was a secretary of the Central Committee in 1927–1928 and RSFSR People’s Commissar of Agriculture from February 1928 to December 1929. Arrested in June 1937, he was shot on 27 November and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.ko: 1911년 상트페테르부르크의 농민 집안에서 태어나 1932년 레닌그라드 낙농축산대학을 마친 축산 기술자다. 국영농장 기술자·농장장을 거쳐 1939~1940년 러시아 공화국 국영농장 부인민위원을 지냈고, 1939년 공산당에 들어갔다. 1940~1946년 당 중앙위원회 농업부 부부장, 1946~1947년 소련 축산부 장관, 1948~1953년 당 중앙위원회 농업부장을 지냈다. 스탈린 사후인 1953년 3~9월 통합된 소련 농업·조달부 장관, 1953~1955년 국영농장부 장관을 지냈으나 「업무를 감당하지 못한다」는 이유로 해임되어 처녀지의 국영농장장으로 보내졌다. 이후 카자흐스탄 국영농장부 장관 등을 거쳐 1977년 은퇴했다.
bio.en: Born in 1911 into a peasant family in St Petersburg, he graduated from the Leningrad Institute of Dairy Livestock Farming in 1932 as a livestock specialist. After working as a state-farm specialist and director he became deputy People’s Commissar of State Farms of the RSFSR in 1939–1940, and he joined the party in 1939. He was deputy head of the Central Committee’s agriculture department in 1940–1946, USSR Minister of Livestock Farming in 1946–1947 and head of the Central Committee’s agriculture department in 1948–1953. After Stalin’s death he was Minister of Agriculture and Procurement of the merged ministry from March to September 1953 and Minister of State Farms in 1953–1955, until he was dismissed as “not coping with the work” and sent to the Virgin Lands as a state-farm director. He later served as Minister of State Farms of Kazakhstan among other posts and retired in 1977.

bio.en: Born in 1910 into a poor peasant family in Yekaterinovka, Perm Governorate, he worked as a village teacher and graduated from the Molotov (Perm) Agricultural Institute in 1935 as a livestock specialist. He joined the party in 1939 and earned a candidate degree in agricultural sciences in 1944. After serving as second secretary of the Molotov regional party committee and chairman of the regional executive committee, he became chairman of the Altai Krai executive committee in 1949 and first secretary of the Altai Krai party committee in July 1955. He was USSR Minister of Agriculture in 1962–1963, an inspector of the Central Committee in 1963–1964 and first deputy chairman of the RSFSR Council of Ministers in 1964–1971, and a member of the Central Committee from 1956 to 1971.

bio.en: Born in January 1917 (December 1916 Old Style) into a peasant family in Karyzh, Kursk Governorate, he graduated from the Voronezh Agricultural Institute in 1942 as an agronomist. In the Great Patriotic War he served as deputy company commander for technical affairs in Guards tank formations, and he joined the party in 1946. As director of the Petrovsky state farm in Lipetsk Oblast in 1951–1963 he was made a Hero of Socialist Labour in 1961. He was USSR Minister of Agriculture in 1963–1965, first deputy minister in 1965–1972 and RSFSR Minister of State Farms in 1972–1975, and in 1977–1983 he was agricultural attaché at the Soviet embassy in East Germany.

bio.en: Born in Grozny in 1938, he graduated from the Tashkent Institute of Irrigation and Agricultural Mechanisation Engineers in 1963. He worked at the All-Union Research Institute for the Repair and Operation of Machine-Tractor Fleets and in 1979–1983 was director general of the Remdetal research-and-production association. He was deputy chairman of the USSR State Agro-Industrial Committee in 1985–1989 and first deputy chairman of the Council of Ministers’ State Commission for Food and Procurement in 1989–1991, and in 1991 became USSR Minister of Agriculture and Food. After the Soviet Union’s collapse he was Russia’s deputy minister of agriculture and food in 1997–1999 and director of the GOSNITI machine-repair institute, and he became a full member of VASKhNIL in 1991 and of the Russian Academy of Sciences in 2013.

He became RSFSR Minister of Agriculture in 1985, and in 1989–1990 he was first deputy chairman of the USSR Council of Ministers and chairman of its State Commission for Food and Procurement. He was a candidate member of the Central Committee in 1986–1990. Gorbachev dismissed him on 31 August 1990 over a cigarette shortage that had set off demonstrations in Moscow.

bio.ko: 1897년 사마라현 니콜라옙스크의 농민 집안에서 태어나 1918년 김나지움을 마치고 러시아 공산당(볼셰비키)에 들어갔다. 사마라 현 교육국장, 교육인민위원부 사회주의 교육 총국장, 고리키 기계공업대학·레닌그라드 공업대학 학장을 거쳐 1937년 9~10월 레닌그라드주 집행위원회 의장을 지냈다. 1937년 10월~1940년 2월 러시아 공화국 교육인민위원으로 교과서 무상 배포와 통일 학교 교육과정을 추진했다. 독소전쟁 때 레닌그라드 전선 정치국장을 지내고 1942년 소장이 되었으나, 1949년 「레닌그라드 사건」으로 당에서 제명·체포되어 1950년 부티르카 감옥 병원에서 죽었고, 1954년 사건이 무혐의로 종결되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1897 into a peasant family in Nikolayevsk, Samara Governorate, he finished gymnasium and joined the RCP(b) in 1918. After heading the Samara provincial education department and the Commissariat of Education’s Main Administration of Socialist Education and directing engineering institutes in Gorky and Leningrad, he chaired the Leningrad regional executive committee in September–October 1937. As RSFSR People’s Commissar of Education from October 1937 to February 1940 he pushed free distribution of textbooks and uniform school curricula. In the Great Patriotic War he headed the political administration of the Leningrad Front and became a major general in 1942, but in 1949 he was expelled from the party and arrested in the Leningrad affair, and he died in the Butyrka prison hospital in 1950; the case was closed for lack of a crime in 1954.

bio.ko: 1900년 펜자의 가구공 집안에서 태어났고 본성은 키르피치니코프다. 1918년 적위대에 들어가 반란 진압 부대를 지휘했고 같은 해 러시아 공산당(볼셰비키)에 들어갔으며, 내전기 체카 특수부 등에서 복무했다. 1928년부터 러시아 프롤레타리아 작가 협회(RAPP) 서기를 지냈고, 1932년부터 당 중앙위원회의 위임으로 소련 작가동맹 조직에 참여했다. 1936~1941년 작가동맹 서기장, 1937~1941년 잡지 「노비 미르」 주필을 지냈다. 1938년 3월 예조프 내무인민위원에게 시인 만델슈탐 「문제를 해결해 달라」는 서한을 보냈고, 곧 만델슈탐은 체포되었다. 독소전쟁 때 「프라우다」 특파 종군기자로 일하다 1943년 11월 네벨 근처에서 전사했다.
bio.en: Born Vladimir Kirpichnikov in Penza in 1900, the son of a cabinet-maker, he joined the Red Guard in 1918, commanded a unit suppressing uprisings and joined the RCP(b) the same year, serving in Cheka special departments during the Civil War. From 1924 he worked as a journalist and writer in Rostov-on-Don, from 1928 he was a secretary of the Russian Association of Proletarian Writers in Moscow, and from 1932 he helped organise the Union of Soviet Writers on the Central Committee’s instructions. He was general secretary of the Writers’ Union in 1936–1941 and editor of Novy Mir in 1937–1941. In March 1938 he wrote to People’s Commissar of Internal Affairs Yezhov asking him to “resolve the question of Mandelstam”, and the poet was soon arrested. A special war correspondent for Pravda in the Great Patriotic War, he was killed near Nevel in November 1943.

bio.ko: 1922년 오렌부르크에서 태어나 타슈켄트에서 자랐다. 1941년 타슈켄트 보병학교 생도 시절 반소 선동 혐의로 5년형을 받았고, 1942년 형벌 중대로 전선에 나갔다. 1943년 공로로 전과가 말소되고 전연방 공산당(볼셰비키)에 들어갔으며, 정찰 소대장으로 포로 79명을 잡아 1944년 소련 영웅 칭호를 받았다. 전후 프룬제 군사 아카데미와 고리키 문학대학을 마치고 총참모부 정보총국과 투르키스탄 군관구에서 복무했다. 1981~1986년 「노비 미르」 편집장, 1986~1991년 소련 작가동맹 이사회 제1서기를 지냈고, 1986~1988년 소련공산당 중앙위원 후보, 1988~1991년 중앙위원이었다. 2010년 모스크바에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Orenburg in 1922, he grew up in Tashkent. In 1941, as a cadet of the Tashkent infantry school, he was sentenced to five years for anti-Soviet agitation, and in 1942 he went to the front in a penal company. In 1943 his conviction was lifted for distinction in battle and he joined the VKP(b); as a reconnaissance platoon commander he took 79 prisoners and was made a Hero of the Soviet Union in 1944. After the war he graduated from the Frunze Military Academy and the Gorky Literary Institute and served in the GRU of the General Staff and the Turkestan Military District. He is known for the novels The Tarazi Turtle and Floating Eurasia, and was named People's Writer of the Uzbek SSR in 1989.

bio.ko: 1897년 뱌트카 현 노동자 마을에서 태어나 목수로 일했고, 1916년 혁명 활동으로 체포되었다가 2월 혁명으로 풀려났다. 1917년 3월 볼셰비키에 들어갔고 내전기에는 연대·사단 정치위원으로 싸웠으며 1921년 크론시타트 반란 진압에 참여했다. 1920~1930년대 발트 해 해군과 여러 군관구의 정치국장을 거쳐 1937년 6월 가마르니크의 뒤를 이어 붉은 군대 정치총국장, 9월 국방 인민위원 대리가 되었다. 1937년 12월 30일 새로 만든 소련 해군 인민위원부의 초대 인민위원에 임명되었고, 1937년 하반기 붉은 군대 숙청의 주요 조직자 가운데 하나였다. 1938년 6월 30일 체포되어 1939년 2월 '군사 파시스트 음모' 혐의로 총살되었고 1956년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1897 in Vyatka Governorate, he worked as a joiner; jailed in 1916 for revolutionary activity, he was freed by the February Revolution. He joined the Bolsheviks in March 1917, fought in the Civil War as a regimental and divisional commissar, and took part in suppressing the Kronstadt rebellion in 1921. After heading political directorates of the Baltic naval forces and several military districts, he succeeded Gamarnik as head of the Red Army Political Directorate in June 1937 and became Deputy People's Commissar of Defence in September. On 30 December 1937 he was appointed the first People's Commissar of the newly created Navy commissariat, and he was one of the main organisers of the 1937 Red Army purge. Arrested on 30 June 1938, he was shot in February 1939 on charges of a 'military-fascist conspiracy' and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.ko: 1897년 돈 군관구 술린에서 카자크 출신 지방 의사의 아들로 태어나 1914년 러시아 사회민주노동당에 들어갔다. 1917년 크론시타트 볼셰비키 위원회 신문을 '스베틀롭스키'라는 필명으로 편집했고, 10월 봉기 때 크론시타트 수병 연합부대의 정치위원 겸 참모장을 맡았다. 내전기에 볼가·드네프르 군사 소함대를 지휘했고, 1927년 해군 아카데미를 마친 뒤 구축함과 구축함 전대를 지휘했다. 1937년 8월 흑해 함대 사령관, 12월 해군 제1인민위원 대리가 되었고, 1938년 6월 30일 표트르 스미르노프가 체포되자 9월 8일 프리놉스키가 임명될 때까지 해군 인민위원 직무를 대행했다. 1939년 3월 체포되어 1940년 3월 총살되었고 1956년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1897 at Sulin in the Don Host Oblast, the son of a Cossack who worked as a zemstvo doctor, he joined the RSDLP in 1914. In 1917 he edited the newspapers of the Kronstadt Bolshevik committee under the pen name Svetlovsky, and in the October rising he was commissar and chief of staff of the combined Kronstadt sailors' detachment. In the Civil War he commanded the Volga and Dnieper military flotillas, and after graduating from the Naval Academy in 1927 he commanded a destroyer and a destroyer division. He became commander of the Black Sea Fleet in August 1937 and First Deputy People's Commissar of the Navy in December, and after Pyotr Smirnov's arrest on 30 June 1938 he acted as People's Commissar of the Navy until Frinovsky's appointment on 8 September. Arrested in March 1939, he was shot in March 1940 and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.en: Born in 1871 into a merchant family in Bălți, Bessarabia, he trained as a pharmacist. Jailed in 1899 for his part in the Izhora workers' strike, he was exiled to Yenisei Governorate and in 1901 joined the Krasnoyarsk committee of the RSDLP. In 1906 he was editorial secretary of Novaya Zhizn; later he left revolutionary work and managed oil companies. After the February Revolution of 1917 he became treasurer of the Bolshevik Petrograd Committee, and after the October Revolution he served as Deputy People's Commissar of Finance and then, from 21 March to 16 August 1918, as People's Commissar of Finance of the RSFSR. From 1920 he was envoy and trade representative in Estonia; in 1921 the Politburo referred his case to the Supreme Tribunal over his handling of funds, but he died of pneumonia before the trial.

bio.en: Born in 1887 in Ostrov, Pskov Governorate, he worked as a bookkeeper for private firms and banks and served as a Red Cross orderly in the First World War. He joined the RSDLP(b) after the February Revolution, entered the State Bank in December 1917, and headed the People's Bank of the Northern Region in 1918–1919. From 1921 he was a board member of the State Bank and a member of the collegium of the finance commissariat, taking part in the currency reform of 1922–1924, and from March 1924 to January 1926 he was acting chairman of the Board of the State Bank of the USSR. He then sat on the presidium of Gosplan and served as trade representative in France, and in 1932 became chairman of the board of the Industrial Bank. Arrested in August 1936, he was sentenced to death in September and shot; he was rehabilitated in 1964.

bio.en: Born in 1899 into a Jewish family in Oryol, he joined the RKP(b) in 1918 and served as a commissar in the Red Army in 1920–1925. After leaving the army he studied at the Institute of Red Professors and headed its preparatory department, and from November 1930 he worked in the planning-economic directorate of the Supreme Council of the National Economy. He was a member of the Central Control Commission of the VKP(b) in 1930–1934 and head of the central planning sector of the People's Commissariat of Heavy Industry in 1934–1936. In July 1936 he became chairman of the Board of the State Bank of the USSR and Deputy People's Commissar of Finance, but he was arrested in September 1937, sentenced to death in 1938 for membership in a counter-revolutionary terrorist organisation and shot. He was rehabilitated in 1955.

He joined the RSDLP(b) in November 1917 and was a Red Army commissar and political officer through the 1920s. From 1929 he worked in the Central Committee apparatus, and was second secretary of the Far Eastern regional committee in 1932–1933. He chaired the Leningrad oblast executive committee from February 1936 to September 1937, and on 13 September 1937 became chairman of the Board of the State Bank of the USSR, the first to sit in the Council of People's Commissars with the rank of commissar. Arrested in July 1938, he was shot in February 1939 for 'participation in a counter-revolutionary terrorist organisation' and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.ko: 1898년 모길료프현에서 태어나 내전기에 붉은 근위대와 붉은 군대에서 측량병, 여단 정치부장 등으로 복무했다. 1920년대에 「프라우다」 편집국, 노농 감찰, 소련 영화사 소유즈키노 수출입부에서 일했고, 1929~1930년 독일 주재 무역대표부에서 소유즈키노 전권대표를 지냈다. 1934년 붉은 교수 경제연구소를 마치고 대외무역 아카데미 대학원을 거쳐 1936~1937년 그 아카데미 원장이 되었다. 1937년 대외무역부인민위원, 1938년 대외무역인민위원이 되었다. 1939년 4월 체포되어 간첩 혐의로 1940년 처형되었고, 1956년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1898 in Mogilev Governorate, he served in the Civil War in the Red Guard and the Red Army as a topographer and head of a brigade political department. In the 1920s he worked on the editorial staff of Pravda, in the Workers' and Peasants' Inspection and in the export-import department of Soyuzkino, and in 1929–1930 he was Soyuzkino's plenipotentiary at the Soviet trade mission in Germany. After the Economic Institute of Red Professors (1934) and postgraduate study at the Academy of Foreign Trade, he directed that academy in 1936–1937. He became Deputy People's Commissar and then, in 1938, People's Commissar of Foreign Trade. Arrested in April 1939, he was executed on espionage charges in 1940 and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.en: Born in 1901 in Kaluga Governorate, he graduated in 1924 from the foreign-relations course of the social sciences faculty of the 1st Moscow State University. From 1924 he worked against smuggling in the Main Customs Directorate of the People's Commissariat of Trade, then in the foreign sectors of the commissariats of supply and the food industry, and from 1939 headed the Eastern Directorate and later the Trade Agreements Directorate of the People's Commissariat of Foreign Trade. After serving as first deputy minister from 1949, he was Minister of Foreign Trade of the USSR in 1951–1953. As deputy minister of foreign trade in 1953–1969 he also represented the USSR in Comecon, and he was a candidate member of the CPSU Central Committee in 1952–1966.

bio.en: Born in 1935 in Donetsk Oblast, he graduated in mechanics from Dnipropetrovsk State University in 1958. He worked at a design bureau and plants in Zlatoust, directed the Ust-Katav Wagon Works in 1967–1976 and, in 1976–1983, the Zlatoust Machine-Building Plant, which built submarine-launched ballistic missiles. After serving as deputy minister from 1983 and first deputy minister from 1987, he was Minister of General Machine Building from March 1988 to June 1989. In 1989 he became deputy chairman of the Council of Ministers and chairman of the State Commission for Emergencies, and in January 1991 First Deputy Prime Minister. bio.ko: 1880년 트빌리시의 아르메니아인 교사 집안에서 태어나 모스크바 대학 법학부에서 공부했고, 1903년 러시아 사회민주노동당 모스크바 학생 그룹에 들어갔다. 학생 운동으로 여러 번 처벌받았고, 1917년까지 모스크바에서 변호사로 일했다. 혁명 뒤 제11군 신문 「붉은 병사」 편집자를 지냈고, 1920년 6월~1921년 10월 러시아 공산당 중앙위원회 선동선전부장, 1921년 1~4월 체카 해외부장을 지냈다. 1922년 베를린 총영사를 거쳐 검찰로 옮겨 오게페우 감독을 맡았고, 1933~1938년 소련 최고재판소 특별사건 담당 수석 검사보로 정치 재판의 공소를 맡았다. 1938년 체포되어 1955년까지 수감과 유형을 겪은 뒤 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1880 into the family of an Armenian schoolteacher in Tbilisi, he studied law at Moscow University and in 1903 joined the Moscow student group of the RSDLP. Repeatedly punished for student activism, he practised as a lawyer in Moscow until 1917. After the revolution he edited the 11th Army newspaper Krasny Voin, headed the Agitation and Propaganda Department of the RCP(b) Central Committee from June 1920 to October 1921, and led the Foreign Department of the Cheka from January to April 1921. After serving as consul general in Berlin from 1922 he moved to the procuracy, supervising the OGPU, and in 1933–1938 was senior assistant prosecutor of the USSR Supreme Court for special cases and a state prosecutor at political trials. Arrested in 1938, he spent the years until 1955 in prison and exile and was then rehabilitated.

bio.ko: 1886년 오렌부르크에서 유대인 퇴역 병사의 아들로 태어나 1903년 사마라에서 러시아 사회민주노동당에 들어갔고, 1904년 볼셰비키 분파에 가담했다. 혁명 전 노동조합을 조직하고 「프라우다」에 글을 쓰다 첼랴빈스크로 유형되었다. 1917년 우랄 주 소비에트 의장을 지냈고, 1918~1924년 전러시아 중앙집행위원회 상임위원, 농민 신문 「베드노타」 편집자로 일했으며 1921년 10월~1922년 5월 중앙위원회 선동선전부장을 맡았다. 1923년 「46인 선언」에 서명하고 좌익반대파에 섰다가 1927년 제15차 당대회에서 제명되어 유형과 수감을 겪었다. 1934년 반대파를 버린다고 밝혀 1935년 복당했으나 1936년 다시 체포되어 1937년 처형되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1886 in Orenburg, the son of a Jewish retired soldier, he joined the RSDLP in Samara in 1903 and the Bolshevik faction in 1904. Before the revolution he organised trade unions and wrote for Pravda, and was repeatedly arrested and banished to Chelyabinsk. In 1917 he chaired the Urals Regional Soviet; in 1918–1924 he sat on the Presidium of the All-Russian Central Executive Committee and edited the peasant newspaper Bednota, and from October 1921 to May 1922 he headed the Central Committee's Agitation and Propaganda Department. He signed the Declaration of 46 in 1923 and joined the Left Opposition, was expelled at the 15th Party Congress in 1927, and went through exile and political isolators. After renouncing the opposition in 1934 he was readmitted to the party in 1935, but he was arrested again in 1936 and shot in 1937.

bio.ko: 1894년 트베리에서 태어나 모스크바 대학 물리수학부에서 공부하던 1915년 볼셰비키에 들어가 학생 사이에서 선전하다 체포되어 동시베리아 유형을 선고받았다. 1917년 3월 사면된 뒤 트베리 당위원회를 이끌었고, 1920년대 초까지 사라토프·옴스크·도네츠크 등지의 당위원회 비서를 지냈다. 1924~1927년 벨라루스 공산당 중앙위원회 책임비서와 제1서기를 지냈다. 1927년 5월부터 중앙위원회 선동선전부장, 1928~1929년 선동·선전·출판부장을 맡았고, 이후 자캅카스 지방위원회 제1서기, 농업부인민위원을 거쳐 1934년부터 사라토프 지방위원회 제1서기를 지냈다. 1937년 7월 체포되어 10월 처형되었고 1956년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1894 in Tver, he joined the Bolsheviks in 1915 while studying physics and mathematics at Moscow University, campaigned among students, and was arrested and sentenced to settlement in Eastern Siberia. Amnestied in March 1917, he led the Tver party committee and until the mid-1920s was secretary of party committees in Saratov, Omsk, Donetsk and elsewhere. In 1924–1927 he was responsible secretary and then First Secretary of the Communist Party of Byelorussia. From May 1927 he headed the Central Committee's Agitation and Propaganda Department and in 1928–1929 its Department of Agitation, Propaganda and the Press; he then served as First Secretary of the Transcaucasian Regional Committee and deputy People's Commissar of Agriculture, and from 1934 led the Saratov party committee. Arrested in July 1937, he was shot in October and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.ko: 1922년 지금의 볼고그라드주에서 태어나 1942~1947년 콤소몰에서 일했고 1943년 공산당에 들어갔다. 1957년 중앙위원회 사회과학 아카데미 대학원을 마친 뒤 중앙위원회 기구에서 일하며 1969년 선전부 부부장, 1974년 제1부부장이 되었고 몇 해 동안 부장 직무를 대행했다. 역사적 유물론과 과학적 공산주의를 연구한 철학자로 1971년 「소비에트 인간」을 냈다. 1983~1985년 소련 과학아카데미 철학연구소장, 1985~1987년 고르바초프 서기장의 이념 담당 보좌관, 1987~1991년 마르크스-레닌주의 연구소장을 지냈고 1987년 과학아카데미 정회원이 되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1922 in what is now Volgograd Oblast, he worked in the Komsomol in 1942–1947 and joined the Communist Party in 1943. After postgraduate study at the Central Committee's Academy of Social Sciences, completed in 1957, he worked in the Central Committee apparatus, becoming deputy head of the Propaganda Department in 1969 and first deputy head in 1974, and for several years he acted as its head. A philosopher of historical materialism and scientific communism, he published The Soviet Man in 1971. He directed the Institute of Philosophy of the USSR Academy of Sciences in 1983–1985, was General Secretary Gorbachev's aide for ideology in 1985–1987, and directed the Institute of Marxism–Leninism in 1987–1991; he became a full member of the Academy in 1987.

bio.en: Born in Kursk in 1925, he was conscripted in 1943, fought in anti-tank artillery and took part in the 1945 Victory Parade. He joined the Communist Party in 1944. After graduating from the history faculty of Kharkiv State University in 1951 he taught there and worked in the lecturers' groups of the Kharkiv city and regional party committees, and in 1964–1969 he was a secretary of the Kharkiv regional committee. He became deputy head of the Central Committee Propaganda Department in 1969, first deputy editor of Pravda in 1976 and editor of the journal Problems of Peace and Socialism in 1982, and headed the Central Committee Propaganda Department from July 1986 to November 1988.

bio.en: Born in 1933 in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, he studied Ukrainian philology at Dnipropetrovsk State University, graduating in 1957. He rose through the Ukrainian Komsomol to be its first secretary in 1968–1972, then served as a secretary of the Kyiv regional committee and head of the Culture Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Ukraine, and was a secretary of that Central Committee in 1979–1986. After serving as ambassador to Cuba in 1986–1988, he headed the Ideological Department of the CPSU Central Committee in 1988–1990. He was Soviet and then Russian ambassador to North Korea from October 1990 to January 1992, and later worked as a sociologist at the Institute of Socio-Political Research of the Russian Academy of Sciences.

bio.en: Born in 1946 in Tiksi in the Yakut ASSR, the son of a hydrographic ship captain, he grew up in Chukotka. He graduated from the history faculty of Leningrad University, joined the CPSU in 1970 and in 1981 earned a doctorate in history for research on rural settlement in medieval Russia. After serving as deputy secretary of the university party committee, he headed the science and education department of the Leningrad city party committee from 1982 and was a secretary of the Leningrad regional committee in 1986–1988. He became first deputy head of the CPSU Central Committee's Ideological Department in 1988 and its head in 1990–1991, and was elected to the Central Committee in July 1990. In the 1990s he worked at the Analytical Centre of the Russian Academy of Sciences and in publishing; he died in 2022.

bio.ko: 1930년 탈디코르간 지역의 카를리가시 마을에서 태어나 알마아타의 카자흐 국립대학 언론학부를 다녔고 1953년 소련공산당에 들어갔다. 「문학 신문」 중앙아시아 특파원, 카자흐필름 편집장, 주간지 「카자흐 아데비예티」 편집장을 지냈고, 1970~1979년 카자흐스탄 작가동맹 제1서기, 1986년까지 소련 작가동맹 이사회 서기였다. 1991년 10월 29일 소련 최고소비에트 공화국 소비에트 의장이 되었고, 그의 주재로 공화국 소비에트는 1991년 12월 26일 소련의 존재 종식 선언을 채택했다. 같은 해 카자흐스탄 공산당 다수파가 바뀐 카자흐스탄 사회당 의장으로 뽑혔다. 1993년 알마아타에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in 1930 in the village of Karlygash in the Taldykorgan region, he studied journalism at the Kazakh State University in Alma-Ata and joined the CPSU in 1953. He was Central Asian correspondent of Literaturnaya Gazeta, editor-in-chief of the Kazakhfilm studio and of the weekly Kazakh Adebieti, First Secretary of the Writers' Union of Kazakhstan in 1970–1979 and a secretary of the Board of the USSR Writers' Union until 1986. On 29 October 1991 he became chairman of the Soviet of the Republics of the USSR Supreme Soviet, which under his chairmanship adopted the declaration on the termination of the USSR on 26 December 1991. The same year he was elected chairman of the Socialist Party of Kazakhstan, into which most of the Communist Party of Kazakhstan had been transformed. He died in Alma-Ata in 1993.

bio.en: Born in Moscow in 1887 to a railway employee, he joined the RSDLP in 1903. He lived in Swiss exile in 1906–1907 and after his return was repeatedly arrested and banished. In 1918 he was responsible secretary of the Moscow regional party committee and sat on the collegium of the RSFSR NKVD, and from April 1919 to May 1920 he headed the Central Committee's Registration and Assignment Department. He was a Left Communist during the Brest-Litovsk dispute, belonged to the Democratic Centralists in 1920–1921 and signed the Platform of the 46 in 1923, but broke with the oppositions after the 14th Party Congress. He later served as deputy People's Commissar of Education and dean at the Timiryazev Agricultural Academy; arrested in 1937, he died in exile in 1941 and was rehabilitated in 1955.

bio.ko: 1896년 리가에서 마부의 아들로 태어난 라트비아인으로, 1914년 러시아 사회민주노동당(볼셰비키)에 들어갔다. 1917년 예카테린부르크 당위원회 서기를 지냈고, 내전기에는 제30소총사단 정치부장을 거쳐 동부전선 제3군 정치부장이 되었다. 1920년 1~5월 중앙위원회 총무국장과 등록배치부장을 겸했고, 이후 투르키스탄 사무국 서기, 쿠르스크·뱌트카 현당위원회 책임비서, 우즈베키스탄 공산당 제2서기를 지냈다. 1933~1937년 타타르 주당위원회 제1서기로 있으면서 내무인민위원부 특별 3인 위원회에 들어 대숙청에 적극 가담했다. 1937년 10월 체포되어 1938년 5월 카잔에서 총살되었고 1955년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born in Riga in 1896, the son of a cab driver and a Latvian by nationality, he joined the RSDLP (Bolsheviks) in 1914. In 1917 he was secretary of the Yekaterinburg party committee; in the Civil War he rose from head of the political department of the 30th Rifle Division to head of the political department of the 3rd Army on the Eastern Front. From January to May 1920 he was both business manager of the Central Committee and head of its Registration and Assignment Department; he then served as secretary of the Turkestan Bureau, responsible secretary of the Kursk and Vyatka provincial committees and second secretary of the Communist Party of Uzbekistan. As first secretary of the Tatar regional committee in 1933–1937 he sat on an NKVD special troika and took an active part in the repressions. Arrested in October 1937, he was shot in Kazan in May 1938 and rehabilitated in 1955.

bio.ko: 본명은 아르카디 이오시포비치 말스키로, 1892년 볼히니아현 로지셰에서 태어난 유대인이다. 1908년 폴란드 사회민주당에 들어가 노동자 선전을 하다 1913년 체포된 뒤 지하로 들어갔고, 1917년 러시아 사회민주노동당(볼셰비키)에 가입했다. 1917~1919년 보로네시 현 집행위원회 부의장과 재무부장, 1919년 리투아니아·벨라루스 공화국 재무인민위원, 모스크바 소비에트 재무부장을 지냈다. 제9차 당대회 뒤 중앙위원회 등록배치부장이 되어 1921년 10월까지 일했고, 1921~1927년 재무인민위원부 참사회원 겸 재무인민위원 대리를 지냈다. 좌익반대파 지지자였던 그는 1936년 2월 체포되어 11월 총살되었고 1988년 복권되었다.
bio.en: Born Arkady Iosifovich Malsky in 1892 in Rozhishche, Volhynia Governorate, he was Jewish by nationality. He joined the Social Democratic Party of Poland in 1908, carried out propaganda among workers, went underground after his arrest in 1913 and joined the RSDLP (Bolsheviks) in 1917. In 1917–1919 he was deputy chairman of the Voronezh provincial executive committee and head of its finance department; in 1919 he was People's Commissar of Finance of the Lithuanian-Belorussian republic and then head of the Moscow Soviet's finance department. After the 9th Party Congress he became head of the Central Committee's Registration and Assignment Department, serving until October 1921, and from 1921 to 1927 he was a member of the collegium and deputy People's Commissar of Finance. A supporter of the Left Opposition, he was arrested in February 1936, shot in November and rehabilitated in 1988.

bio.en: Born in 1896 to a German father and a Russian schoolteacher mother, he joined the RSDLP (Bolsheviks) in 1916. In 1917–1918 he chaired the Military Revolutionary Committee of Pskov Governorate and then its executive committee, leading the establishment of Soviet power in Pskov. After serving as responsible secretary of the Yekaterinburg provincial committee he was a candidate member of the Central Committee in 1924–1934, and in 1925–1926, as one of Stalin's inner circle, headed the Central Committee's Organisation and Assignment Department. He was first secretary of the Communist Party of Byelorussia in 1930–1932 and a secretary of the Moscow city committee in 1932–1934, and in 1934–1938 a member of the Soviet Control Commission as its plenipotentiary for Uzbekistan and Gorky Region. Arrested in October 1938, he was shot in February 1939 and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.en: Born in Tver in 1890 to a minor office worker, he left the St. Petersburg Mining Institute without a degree. He joined the Bolshevik faction of the RSDLP in 1911 and worked underground as a member of the St. Petersburg Committee in 1912–1914. After the revolution he worked in the Petrograd party organisation, and as secretary of the North-Western Bureau in 1924–1926 he fought the Zinoviev opposition. From March 1926 to January 1930 he headed the Central Committee's Organisation and Assignment Department, and in 1930 its Assignment Department; Nikolai Yezhov began working under him in this period. A member of the Central Committee and the Orgburo in 1927–1934, he then handled personnel at the Supreme Council of the National Economy and the heavy industry commissariat and sat on the Soviet Control Commission. Arrested in June 1937, he was shot in November and rehabilitated in 1956.

bio.en: Born in 1889 into a poor peasant family in Tver Governorate, he became a Bolshevik in 1912 and was exiled to the Turukhansk region in 1915. In 1917 he was elected to the Constituent Assembly on the Bolshevik list, and in the Brest-Litovsk dispute he backed the Left Communists. After chairing the Tver and Smolensk provincial executive committees, he headed the Central Committee's Organisation and Instruction Department in 1930–1931 and the OGPU personnel department in 1931–1934. From March 1934 to March 1935 he headed the Central Committee's Department of Leading Party Organs, and as first secretary of the Omsk regional committee in 1935–1937 he sat on an NKVD special troika and took an active part in the repressions. Removed and expelled in 1937, he was arrested in 1938, shot in Kuibyshev in 1941 and rehabilitated in 1954.

bio.en: Born in 1903 in the village of Nikitino in Smolensk Governorate, he joined the RCP(b) in 1924. After Komsomol and party work in the Smolensk area he studied at the Moscow Machine-Building Institute and worked at aircraft plants in Moscow and Irkutsk. In 1938 he was a secretary of the Rostov regional committee and deputy head of the Central Committee's Department of Leading Party Organs, and from 1938 to 1945 a secretary of the Komsomol Central Committee. In the war he sat on the military councils of the Separate Guards Airborne Army and the 9th Guards Army, becoming a lieutenant general in 1944. From June to December 1950 he headed the Central Committee's Department of Party, Trade-Union and Komsomol Organs and then its Administrative Department, and in 1956–1961 he was responsible secretary of the party commission of the army's Main Political Directorate. He died in Moscow in 1973.

bio.en: Born in Chernigov Governorate in 1909, he joined the VKP(b) in 1932. In 1941–1946 he was a secretary and then first secretary of district party committees in Moscow, and afterwards a deputy department head of the Moscow city committee. He was deputy head of the Central Committee's Department of Party, Trade-Union and Komsomol Organs in 1948–1952, its head from April 1953 to March 1954, and head of the Central Committee's Department of Party Organs for the Union Republics in 1954–1957. He was Soviet ambassador to Hungary from March 1957 to May 1959 and head of the Fourth European Department of the Foreign Ministry in 1960–1969. A candidate member of the CPSU Central Committee in 1956–1961, he died in Moscow in 1981.

bio.ko: 1904년 벨고로드에서 노동자의 아들로 태어나 1929년 전연방 공산당(볼셰비키)에 들어갔다. 하르코프 공구기계 공장에서 직장·수석 기계기사로 일한 뒤 당 일로 옮겨 1940~1943년 하르코프 시당위원회 제2서기, 1944~1950년 하르코프 주당위원회 제1서기를 지냈다. 1952년부터 중앙위원회 당기관부에서 일했고, 1955~1959년 러시아 공화국 담당 당기관부장, 1959~1961년 연방공화국 담당 당기관부장이었다. 1957년 6월 「반당 그룹」의 흐루쇼프 해임 시도를 막는 데 힘을 보탰고, 1961~1971년 소련공산당 중앙위원이었다. 1967~1981년 소련 인민통제위원회 부의장을 지내고 1982년 모스크바에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Belgorod in 1904 to a worker's family, he joined the VKP(b) in 1929. After working as a foreman and chief mechanic at the Kharkov machine-tool plant he moved to party work, serving as second secretary of the Kharkov city committee in 1940–1943 and first secretary of the Kharkov regional committee in 1944–1950. He worked in the Central Committee's party organs department from 1952, heading the Department of Party Organs for the RSFSR in 1955–1959 and the Department of Party Organs for the Union Republics in 1959–1961. In June 1957 he helped thwart the Anti-Party Group's attempt to remove Khrushchev, and he was a member of the CPSU Central Committee in 1961–1971. He was deputy chairman of the USSR People's Control Committee in 1967–1981 and died in Moscow in 1982.

bio.en: Born in 1907 in the village of Starye Virki in Kursk Governorate, he graduated from the Kharkov Civil Engineering Institute in 1935 and stayed there as a graduate student and lecturer; he joined the VKP(b) in 1938. From 1944 he did party work in Ukraine and was First Secretary of the Kharkov regional party committee in 1953–1961. From March 1961 to 1965 he headed the CPSU Central Committee Department of Party Organs for the Union Republics, and he was also a Central Committee secretary in 1962–1965. After serving as Second Secretary of the Communist Party of Kazakhstan in 1965–1971, he was from 1970 First Deputy Permanent Representative of the USSR to Comecon, and he died in Moscow in 1980.

bio.en: Born in 1936 in the village of Novopokrovka in Tambov Oblast, he worked as a local newspaper journalist and joined the CPSU in 1960; from 1968 he held district and regional party posts in Tambov Oblast. In 1981–1982 he was sent to Afghanistan as an adviser to the Central Committee of the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan, and in 1984–1989 he was First Secretary of the Lipetsk regional party committee. He became a Central Committee secretary in September 1989, headed the Department of Party Construction and Cadre Policy from July 1990 and the Central Committee Organisational Department from October 1990, until the party's activity was suspended in August 1991. He was a People's Deputy of the RSFSR in 1990–1993 and died in Moscow in 2021.

bio.en: Born in 1913 in the village of Nelyubova in Oryol Governorate, he graduated from the Voronezh Pedagogical Institute in 1936, joined the VKP(b) in 1940 and did political work in the Red Army in 1942–1945. After serving as a secretary of the Primorsky territorial party committee in 1947–1952 he worked in the Central Committee apparatus and was deputy head of the Department of Party Organs for the RSFSR in 1954–1961. He headed that department in 1961–1962 and the Department of Party Organs for Agriculture of the RSFSR in 1962–1964. In 1966–1978 he was First Deputy Chairman of the RSFSR Council of Ministers Committee for Vocational and Technical Education, and he died in Moscow in 2002.

bio.en: Born in Kursk in 1914, he graduated from the Kursk locomotive technical school in 1935 and worked as a technician. He joined the VKP(b) in 1939, moved into Komsomol and party work and was First Secretary of the Voronezh regional Komsomol in 1942–1943. He was a secretary of the Lipetsk regional party committee in 1954–1957 and Second Secretary of the Dagestan regional party committee in 1957–1961. In 1962–1964 he headed the Central Committee Department of Party Organs for Industry of the RSFSR, and in 1965–1966 he was acting head of the Department of Organisational-Party Work for the RSFSR. From 1968 he was First Secretary of the Chuvash regional party committee, and he died in Cheboksary in 1973.

bio.ko: 1932년 스베르들롭스크에서 태어나 1956년 우랄 공과대학 물리기술학부를 마쳤다. 1956~1975년 동카자흐스탄의 울바 야금공장에서 일했고, 1963년 소련공산당에 들어갔다. 1975~1979년 체페츠크 기계공장장, 1979~1986년 엘렉트로스탈 기계제작공장장을 지냈다. 1986년 중형기계공업부로 옮겨 1988년 차관이 되었고, 1989년 7월부터 1991년까지 소련 원자력에너지·산업장관을 지냈다. 소련 해체 뒤 러시아 원자력부 제1차관과 핵연료 기업 TVEL 사장을 지냈고 2013년 모스크바에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Sverdlovsk in 1932, he graduated from the physics and technology faculty of the Ural Polytechnic Institute in 1956. He worked at the Ulba Metallurgical Plant in East Kazakhstan in 1956–1975 and joined the CPSU in 1963. He was director of the Chepetsk Mechanical Plant in 1975–1979 and of the Elektrostal Machine-Building Plant in 1979–1986. He moved to the Ministry of Medium Machine Building in 1986, became a deputy minister in 1988, and was Minister of Atomic Energy and Industry of the USSR from July 1989 to 1991. After the Soviet collapse he was First Deputy Minister of Atomic Energy of Russia and president of the nuclear-fuel company TVEL, and he died in Moscow in 2013.

epithet.en: Last Soviet Minister of General Machine Building, who oversaw the Energia–Buran launches

bio.ko: 1934년 이바노보 공업주 수도그다에서 태어나 1957년 모스크바 전기통신대학을 마쳤고, 1956년 소련공산당에 들어갔다. 국방부 제22중앙연구소와 NII-88에서 연구원으로 일했고, 1965~1966년 칼리닌그라드(모스크바주) 시당위원회 서기를 지냈다. 1966~1981년 일반기계공업부 산하 측정기술연구소장과 정밀기기 과학생산연합 총책임자 겸 수석설계자를 지냈다. 1981년 일반기계공업부 차관, 1987년 제1차관이 되었고, 1989년 7월 17일부터 1991년 11월 26일까지 소련 일반기계공업장관으로서 에네르기야-부란 발사를 지휘했다. 1991~1994년 로스옵셰마시 사장을 지냈다.
bio.en: Born in 1934 in Sudogda in the Ivanovo Industrial Region, he graduated from the Moscow Electrotechnical Institute of Communications in 1957 and joined the CPSU in 1956. He worked as a researcher at Central Research Institute No. 22 of the Ministry of Defence and at NII-88, and was a secretary of the Kaliningrad (Moscow Oblast) city party committee in 1965–1966. In 1966–1981 he directed the Institute of Measurement Technology and then the Scientific-Production Association of Precision Instruments of the Ministry of General Machine Building as general director and chief designer. He became Deputy Minister of General Machine Building in 1981 and First Deputy Minister in 1987, and as Minister of General Machine Building of the USSR from 17 July 1989 to 26 November 1991 he directed the Energia–Buran launches. In 1991–1994 he was president of the Rosobshchemash corporation.
